authorization: Owner asked to finish PR61 and cross-sport implementation. Research execution only; no wagering or automatic default promotion.

unavailable_source_adapters.nfl: Original model-specific OOF input rows not retained in checkout; packed coefficients and prior evaluation summaries do not replace these. PR50 remains separate.
unavailable_source_adapters.wnba: Frozen fitter requires official-plus-ESPN historical box archives; anonymous residual arrays do not provide game identity or chronology.
unavailable_source_adapters.mlb: Need point-run forecasts with source-bound realized final run differences; winner-only evaluation does not validate completed-game extra-inning distribution.

experiments.change: Only scale residual distribution using absolute fixed-parent predicted margin; ridge=10. Parent heads unchanged.
experiments.primary: paired per-game CRPS; week-block bootstrap 2000 seed7
experiments.secondary: category Brier and logloss on declared hypothetical contracts, 90% interval coverage/width, zero-support outcomes

experiments.change: Only monotone two-parameter CDF transform fit on separate calibration season; no support repair or sample dropping.
experiments.failure: Report fit failure for any zero-supported calibration outcome. No retuning or dropping the outcome.

hypothetical_lines.total: nearest lower half-point to frozen parent point mean; same line across arms; no market quote claimed

model_fit_policy: Fixed parent heads fitted on designated earlier seasons; residual and CDF artifacts frozen before later outcomes are evaluated. Each fitted parent receives its own identity, not a current production ID. No post-evaluation refitting.
chronology: Provider finals reconstructed after the fact. Historical prediction cutoff=start minus one hour; conservative result eligibility=start plus 48 hours. These are simulation assumptions, not capture timestamps. Abort if an assumed result-availability boundary overlaps the next split. Actual writer creation time retained separately.
market_evaluation: NOT_RUN; no verified timestamped two-sided handicap quotes in these sources. No ATS hit-rate or profit claim.
availability: NOT_FITTED; no invented player effects or scenario weights. Requires archived pregame statuses, participation and conditional performance in a separately registered study.
promotion_rule: NONE. History is reused; diagnostic improvements do not promote. All seven prospective cohorts and canonical writer integration still required.
